brief: Applies an expression to each character of a text and collects the results, as a list; the in-place Perform verbs do nothing today.
detail: Build one with new stzStringPerformer("abc"). An expression is text in which @char is the current character and @i its position, such as "upper(@char)" or "@char + @char"; len() inside it counts bytes. Yield returns the result for every character as a list and YieldOn for chosen positions. Perform and PerformOn are meant to rewrite the text and leave it unchanged today, and the W forms (PerformW, YieldW) raise error R14. Use Yield and rebuild the text from the list when you need a rewritten string.
